name: Composite-Only Splatting
definition: The most basic splatting method where object points are traversed in depth order, assigned color/opacity, splatted into screen buffers, and composited with the present image.
summary: Composite-Only Splatting is a foundational volume rendering technique that projects and immediately composites depth-sorted primitives into image buffers, differing from other methods by performing per-primitive compositing rather than using intermediate buffers or global sorting.
